patch:
diff --git a/cohort/stats.py b/cohort/stats.py
index d341e40..84f7029 100644
--- a/cohort/stats.py
+++ b/cohort/stats.py
@@ -7,4 +7,9 @@ def median(values):
     n = len(ordered)
     if n == 0:
         return 0
-    return ordered[n // 2]
+    if n % 2:
+        return ordered[n // 2]
+    # Even-sized: the midpoint of the two middle values, rounded HALF UP
+    # (docs/median.md). Truncating biases every even cohort downward.
+    lower, upper = ordered[n // 2 - 1], ordered[n // 2]
+    return (lower + upper + 1) // 2
prompt:
Finance rejected the August cohort report. The median for north came out 4400.
There are four orders in north — 3000, 4200, 4400 and 5000 — and the two middle
ones are 4200 and 4400, so the median is 4300.

`docs/median.md` has the standard. Please make the report follow it.

`python run.py` must complete and every median it prints has to be the one the
standard gives.

Do not change `data/orders.json` and do not change the report's line shapes —
the finance reconciliation parses them.
